name: Orocovis (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Five vertical stripes of green, white, blue, white and green, the central blue stripe charged with a white oval bearing a yellow sun with seventeen rays.
history: Orocovis is a town and municipality in the centre of Puerto Rico. The green stripes stand for the territories of Aibonito and Barranquitas, the blue for the domain of the cacique Orocobix, the white for the lands granted by Barranquitas and Morovis to form the municipality in 1825, and the sun's seventeen rays for the regions of the town.
